verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party docs describe Obsidian URI, a custom URI protocol for triggering actions such as opening or creating a note. That directly covers driving the app from scripts and workflows via a URI scheme or deep links. The evidence is a single summary-level doc line with no parameter or action detail. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the URI actions and parameters, any local endpoint or API for external control, independent or hands-on corroboration of URI automation.
